interpretationBoundaries: Each original screenshot was viewed once at the tool's available whole-image scale, with no crop, zoomed derivative or reopen.
Visible means present in the complete long-page screenshot, not simultaneously inside the initial viewport.
No obvious clipping or overlap was observed at that scale. This is not a microscopic glyph, exact minimum-font-size, contrast or touch-target guarantee.

The recorded section boxes stay horizontally within pageWidth. Choices records include negative viewport-relative y values; those alone do not establish missing content in the inspected long-page pixels.
Rendered mathematical notation was inspected for appearance and readability only. No physics or mathematics was re-solved and no scientific choice, answer or content review was replayed.

Blue checked boxes and selected radio circles are ordinary displayed selection states, not treated as evidence of correct answers. No visible answer-key designation or correctness feedback was observed in choices.
Read-only denotes the visible prose answer presentation without editor or grading controls; actual DOM immutability and interaction behavior were not tested.
Standard answer prose is intentional on standards pages and is not classified as accidental answer leakage.
Screenshot observations do not prove real-app routing, data loading, selection behavior, grading, accessibility semantics or production integration.
